title: Jeremiah Bible Quiz - Chapter 16
description: Ten questions on Jeremiah 16: no wife or children in this place, no mourning or feasting, fishermen and hunters, and a promised return from the north.

questions.text: What does Yahweh tell the speaker he shall not do in this place?
questions.explanation: Yahweh says, "You shall not take a wife, neither shall you have sons or daughters, in this place."

answers.text: Buy a field or a house in the land
Take a wife or have sons or daughters
Speak to the elders at the gate
Eat bread or drink wine with the people

questions.text: What will the dead bodies of those who die grievous deaths in this land become?
questions.explanation: They will not be lamented or buried but will be as dung on the surface of the ground, and their dead bodies will be food for the birds of the sky and the animals of the earth.

answers.text: A lasting memorial for their children after them
Ashes scattered on the face of the great waters
A warning carved in stone at the city gates
Food for the birds of the sky and the animals of the earth

questions.text: Why is the speaker told not to enter the house of mourning?
questions.explanation: Yahweh says, "Don't enter into the house of mourning... for I have taken away my peace from this people, even loving kindness and tender mercies."

answers.text: Because Yahweh has taken away His peace from this people
Because the dead there had served other gods
Because he would make himself unclean for seven days
Because his enemies lay in wait for him there

questions.text: Besides the house of mourning, which other house is the speaker told not to enter?
questions.explanation: Yahweh also says, "You shall not go into the house of feasting to sit with them, to eat and to drink."

answers.text: The house of the king
The house of the potter
The house of feasting
The house of the scribes

questions.text: Which voices will Yahweh cause to cease out of this place?
questions.explanation: Yahweh will cause to cease the voice of mirth and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom and the voice of the bride.

answers.text: The voices of the prophets and the priests
The voices of mirth, gladness, the bridegroom and the bride
The voices of the watchmen on the walls
The voices of the singers in the temple

questions.text: What answer must the speaker give when the people ask why this great evil is pronounced against them?
questions.explanation: He must tell them it is because their fathers have forsaken Yahweh, walked after other gods, served and worshiped them, and have not kept His law.

answers.text: Because their fathers forsook Yahweh and walked after other gods
Because they refused to pay the tax for the temple
Because they mistreated the prophets sent to them
Because they trusted in the horses of Egypt

questions.text: What will the people do day and night in the land into which they are cast?
questions.explanation: Yahweh says, "I will cast you out of this land into the land that you have not known... There you will serve other gods day and night, for I will show you no favor."

answers.text: Weep by the rivers
Labor in the fields
Cry out for deliverance
Serve other gods

questions.text: What new saying will replace "As Yahweh lives, who brought up the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt"?
questions.explanation: Instead it will be said, "As Yahweh lives, who brought up the children of Israel from the land of the north, and from all the countries where he had driven them."

answers.text: "As Yahweh lives, who planted Israel on his holy mountain"
"As Yahweh lives, who rebuilt the walls of Jerusalem"
"As Yahweh lives, who brought up the children of Israel from the land of the north"
"As Yahweh lives, who gave David the throne forever"

questions.text: Whom does Yahweh say He will send for first, before sending many hunters?
questions.explanation: Yahweh says, "Behold, I will send for many fishermen... and they will fish them up. Afterward I will send for many hunters."

answers.text: Many fishermen
Many soldiers
Many shepherds
Many reapers

questions.text: How will Yahweh first recompense the people's iniquity and sin?
questions.explanation: Yahweh says, "First I will recompense their iniquity and their sin double, because they have polluted my land with the carcasses of their detestable things."

answers.text: Sevenfold
Double
Measure for measure
A tenth at a time
